submission.format: Single PDF by email; main proposal at most 20 pages, excluding the specified front matter, biographies, references, and supplemental portfolio appendices.

requirements.requirement: Inventory existing content, retain/revise/consolidate/archive/remove it with staff, migrate approved pages and assets, identify outdated/duplicate/incomplete content, and establish appropriate existing-URL redirects.
requirements.productAcceptance: Named staff can trace an original record, save a disposition/revision, review current source, release approved content and export the original-to-destination map.

requirements.requirement: Recommend and justify an easy-to-manage secure CMS, with explicit licensing, security, maintenance and training. Staff need create/edit/organize/publish, multiple permission levels, media library, revisions and reusable templates.
requirements.productAcceptance: Native WordPress destination and private migration workspace retain actual role restrictions, editor revisions, review/publication and complete repeatable deployment handoff.

requirements.requirement: Develop accessible responsive layouts, navigation and a DEWR-approved digital style guide covering typography, colors, imagery, spacing, graphics and reusable key page templates.
requirements.deliveryOwner: Prime and DEWR approve identity/design; technical workshare implements agreed components and hands over editable source.

requirements.requirement: Integrate approved existing photography/video/graphics/maps/StoryMaps into project storytelling; support galleries, educational timelines/maps and before/after sliders where appropriate.
requirements.pricingBoundary: New multimedia production and required client assistance are separately identified.

requirements.requirement: Responsive desktop/tablet/mobile and major-browser operation, with the current accepted accessibility standard covering navigation, forms, documents, images, video and interactive content.
requirements.productAcceptance: Actual staff/public workflows work at desktop and narrow viewport; editable image alternative text and GIS text equivalents remain tied to their source records.

requirements.requirement: Fast loading, HTTPS, protection against common vulnerabilities, regular software updates and security practices.
requirements.productAcceptance: Authenticated staff actions, role checks, CSRF, original asset/type verification, explicit host configuration and recovery/update operations are documented and exercised.

requirements.requirement: Search-friendly structure, editable titles/descriptions, XML sitemap, clean URLs, image metadata, site search, navigation/breadcrumbs and document/project/news categories and filters.
requirements.productAcceptance: Released original routes, metadata, categories and search remain exportable and usable in the native destination.

requirements.requirement: Organized searchable/filterable document library with downloadable PDFs/resources and appropriate version management.
requirements.productAcceptance: Exact file identities, reviewed document families/versions, actual same-byte duplicates and source-preserving native attachment mappings survive publication and recovery.

requirements.requirement: Online/contact forms, public comment submission, newsletter integration, and event registration/RSVP if required.
requirements.deliveryOwner: Prime and DEWR select receiving routes, retention and consent details; technical delivery wires the selected forms and preserves actual receiving behavior.

requirements.requirement: News/press releases, public meeting notices and an emergency or important-announcement banner.
requirements.productAcceptance: Staff can prepare/review/publish dated notices with explicit offsets, categories and start/end behavior.

requirements.requirement: ArcGIS Online applications, StoryMaps, interactive maps and future GIS application compatibility.
requirements.productAcceptance: Original item/data/layer identities and provider errors are visible; a reviewed embed has an accessible text equivalent and original external launch link.

requirements.requirement: GA4 or equivalent, traffic/engagement, download tracking and search analytics.
requirements.deliveryOwner: CSKT-owned selected analytics property; configure and document it in the deployment handoff.

requirements.requirement: Recommend hosting/cost/security/maintenance/backups; CSKT retains domains and applicable accounts, full admin access to CMS/analytics/hosting, and the credentials/docs needed for independent management. Name recurring costs and licensing restrictions.
requirements.productAcceptance: Complete source, deployment settings, native records, backup/restore, account ownership and operating guides are handed over in usable form.

requirements.requirement: Maintainable staff/contact entries, public outreach/education and employment/career content that authorized staff can update/archive/remove.
requirements.productAcceptance: Original page records and reviewed page templates preserve required contact/program fields and clean public routes.

requirements.requirement: Staff training, administration guides, independent routine editing, launch coordination and monitoring, plus explicit included warranty/support, response times and extended-support costs.
requirements.productAcceptance: Native staff and public operating journey, source/design files, training materials and recovery instructions accompany the release.

requirements.requirement: Itemize discovery/design/development/migration/training/launch/support, optional services, hosting/recurring costs, warranty, content development/document remediation and multimedia production.
requirements.pricingBoundary: Distinguish technical migration from substantial rewriting, PDF accessibility remediation, new media production, hosting/subscriptions and prime/client design approvals.

preference.requirement: The proposer must supply the specified CSKT Indian Preference certification to receive the preference; tribal membership or affiliation alone does not establish that certification.
